November, 2024

Author: T.Vinod Kumar
Bench: T.Vinod Kumar
 High Court Of Judicature At Hyderabad
 For The State Of Telangana And The State Of Andhra

entities.text:
Assistant City Planner, Circle-18, Greater Hyderabad Municipal
 Corporation, Secunderabad
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text:
.....Respondents  Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, praying that in the circumstances stated in the Affidavit filed herein, the High Court may be pleased to issue a Writ or order or direction, more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus, declaring the action of the respondents in trying to acquire the property of the petitioners in Premises No. 6-4-6/2/1 to 5 consisting of Ground + 5 upper floors situated at Krishna Nagar, Bholakpur,
Secunderabad by passing the order in Proceedings No.C2/266/2015 dated:
19.04.2015 without conducting any hearing contrary to the Provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 as bad arbitrary, illegal and Unconstitutional and consequently direct the respondents to revoke the Form- VI(B) notice in file No.C2/266/2015 dated: 13.02.2015 and the consequential impugned order dated: 19.04.2015 passed by the 3rd respondent;

sentences.text:
1 WPMP. NO. 18114 OF 2015:
 Petition under Section 151 of C.P.C. Praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed in W.P. the High Court may be pleased to stay of all further proceedings in pursuance of the order in proceedings No.C2/266/2015 dated: 19.04.2015 passed by the 3rd respondent in so far as the property of the petitioners in premises No. 6-4-6/2/1 to 5 consisting of Ground + 5 upper  floors situated at Krishna Nagar, Bholakpur, Secunderabad, pending WP No.
13818 of 2015 on the file of the High Court.
 The petition coming on for hearing and upon perusing the petition and affidavit filed herein and order of the High Court dated 01-05- 2015 made herein and upon hearing the arguments of Sri C.Damodar Reddy,
Advocate for the Petitioners, GP for Municipal Administration for Respondent No.1, Sri Challa Madhu, Advocate for Respondent Nos.2 & 5 and of GP for Revenue (TG) for Respondent Nos.3 & 4

, the Court made the following:
ORDER:
Office is directed to post the matter before the appropriate Court having provision of Land Acquisition on 11.06.2015 in motion list.
Interim stay granted on 01.05.2015 stands extended till 16.06.2015.
ASSISTANT REGISTRAR //TRUE COPY// for ASSISTANT REGISTRAR To 1.

Two CCs to GP for Municipal Admn., (TG), High Court Buildings, Hyderabad (OUT)
2.

Two CCs to GP for Revenue, (TG), High Court Buildings, Hyderabad (OUT)
3.
One CC to Sri C. Damodar Reddy, Advocate (OPUC0 4. One Spare Copy
Tvr HIGH COURT PNRJ DATE: 09-06-2015 WP. 13818 OF 2015 STAY EXTENDED DRAFTED: TVR DATED: 10-06-2015 HIGH COURT PNRJ DATE: 09-06-2015 WP.
